_note_num_ctx: The prompt is the claim plus ~200 tokens of instructions, so 2048 leaves roughly 1500 tokens of slack against a 300-token generation cap. Overflow is arithmetically impossible, and a smaller window loads faster and holds less KV cache than the 16384 the verification prompts need.
_note_scope: Targeted test only: the 170 claims needing 4 or more gold elements, where BM25 loses 20-40 points. Not a full-benchmark run.
